text: What is the purpose of the 'wb' mode in the fopen() function?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Opens a file for reading in binary mode

choices.label: B
choices.text: Opens a file for writing in binary mode and overwrites the file if it exists

choices.label: C
choices.text: Appends data to a binary file

choices.label: D

explanation: 'wb' opens a file for writing in binary mode, and if the file already exists, it will overwrite it.

text: What is the purpose of the fseek() function in the following code?

choices.text: It reads data from the file

choices.text: It moves the file pointer to a specific position

choices.label: C
choices.text: It closes the file

choices.label: D

text: What is the purpose of using fseek() in this code?

choices.label: A
choices.text: To move the file pointer to the end of the file

choices.label: B
choices.text: To move the file pointer to the last integer in the file

choices.label: C
choices.text: To move the file pointer to the start of the file

choices.label: D
choices.text: To clear the contents of the file

explanation: fseek is used to move the file pointer to the last integer in the file by going back one integer size from the end.

text: What is the purpose of the fseek() calls in this code?

choices.label: A
choices.text: To move the file pointer to the end of the file to calculate its size and then back to the beginning for reading.

choices.label: B
choices.text: To reset the file pointer to the beginning after calculating the size of the file.

choices.label: C
choices.text: To write data to the file in reverse order.

choices.label: D
choices.text: To delete the content of the file before reading.

explanation: fseek moves the file pointer to the end to calculate the file size and then moves it back to the start for reading the contents.

text: What is the purpose of fseek() in this code?

choices.label: A
choices.text: To read the second last integer from the file

choices.label: B
choices.text: To move the file pointer to the second last integer

choices.label: C
choices.text: To delete the second last integer in the file

choices.label: D
choices.text: To write the second last integer in the file

explanation: The fseek() function is used to move the file pointer to the second last integer in the file. The argument '-2 * sizeof(int)' tells it to move backwards by two integer sizes from the end of the file, and then fread() reads the second last integer.
